edits.before: In the late game this lane is a sustained skill matchup in isolation, but you are winning the broader game through Stand United presses that she cannot replicate. She will try to use Keeper's Verdict to knock your team away from objectives and peel for her carry — coordinate your R to arrive after her ult is burned so you can taunt her without the knockback interrupting the channel. Your Hollow Radiance or Sunfire Aegis stack makes you the more durable frontliner in extended teamfights, and your global R cooldown is roughly half her ult's cooldown at this point, so you simply outpace her macro impact over a long game.
edits.after: In the late game this lane is a sustained skill matchup in isolation, but you are winning the broader game through Stand United presses that she cannot replicate. She will use Keeper's Verdict to knock your team away from objectives, and she is untargetable while she channels it — never dump your taunt or your team's burst into that wind-up, wait it out. Your Hollow Radiance or Sunfire Aegis stack makes you the more durable frontliner in extended teamfights, but your R is the longer cooldown, 160 to her 100, so press it on fights that are already going your way.
